Question Choices: A car uses 1/3 of a tank of gas to drive 1/2 of a standard route. How many tanks does it take to drive the entire route? (Enter as a simplified fraction)
Hints: Divide the amount by the time or other input; multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.
Solution: (1/3) ÷ (1/2) = (1/3) × 2 = 2/3. The quotient is the amount per one unit of the denominator quantity. Check: rate × the original time/input recovers the original amount. Exact calculation: (1 ÷ 3) ÷ (1 ÷ 2) = 2/3.

Question Choices: A hiker climbs 2/3 of a mile in 1/2 of an hour. What is the hiker's speed in miles per hour?
Hints: Divide the amount by the time or other input; multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.
Solution: (2/3) ÷ (1/2) = (2/3) × 2 = 4/3. The quotient is the amount per one unit of the denominator quantity. Check: rate × the original time/input recovers the original amount. Exact calculation: (2 ÷ 3) ÷ (1 ÷ 2) = 4/3.

Question Choices: A worker completes 24 tasks which represent 60% of her weekly goal. How many tasks is the full weekly goal? Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Divide the known part by the percent written as a decimal.
Solution: The known amount is the stated fraction of the whole: 24 = .6 × whole. Divide: whole = 24/.6 = 40. Check: .6 × 40 = 24.
